_comment_: Baseline UI settings, committed to the repo. Reset-to-defaults copies this file over user_data/ui_settings.json. Add new keys here whenever you add a setting, and give it a widget on the settings page. Keys starting with an underscore are treated as comments and stripped on load.
_comment_program_units: Unit system the whole program presents in: SI, MRT or IMP. Input forms open in it and results pages start on it. A loaded preset still overrides it per field, since a preset carries its own units. Renamed from default_output_units in 1.5.
_comment_auto_save: When true, Run saves the inputs automatically instead of prompting for a preset name.
_comment_shortcuts: Keyboard bindings, in Tk event syntax.
